# Religion and Science

*[Russell](../philosophers/russell.md) · 1935*

A history of theology's successive defeats before science, from the place of the Earth to the age of the world, written to show that the retreat to truths 'of another order' always comes after the defeat. The last chapter argues, conversely, that questions of value fall outside science, without thereby falling to religion.
